#include <string>

    std::string inputStr;
    std::getline(std::cin, inputStr);

    int countDiffs = 0;
    char prev = inputStr[0];
    bool flipState = false;

    for (size_t i = 1; i < inputStr.length(); ++i) {
        flipState = !flipState;
        if (i == inputStr.length() - 1 && inputStr[i] == prev && flipState) {
            ++countDiffs;
        }
        if (inputStr[i] != prev) {
            prev = inputStr[i];
            countDiffs += flipState ? 0 : 1;
            flipState = false;
        }
    }
    std::cout << countDiffs << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
